definition: Retrenchment, closure, and lay-off in **large industrial establishments** require **prior conditions**: notice to workmen and government, opportunity for consultation, compensation (e.g. 15 days' wages per year of service for retrenchment — verify current Code), and adherence to **re-employment** obligations where applicable. Exams often test **pre-requisites** before employer can lawfully retrench or close.

statutoryReferences.note: Compare with pre-2014 ID Act §25F, 25FFA, 25-O terminology

cases.name: State Bank of India v. Money
cases.proposition: Often cited on meaning of retrenchment — termination must fall within statutory definition to trigger protections.

examChecklist.text: Effect of non-compliance (void termination / reinstatement remedies)
